stages.name: External grant authority closeout
stages.summary: Verify the Stage 2D canonical external grant table, runtime provider boundary, Development control-plane audit and seven-persona acceptance gate.

stages.name: Appwrite storage and evidence authority
stages.summary: Cut upload-session completion, object verification, immutable evidence metadata and evidence processing queue authority to Appwrite Storage and TablesDB.

stages.name: Transaction and recovery safety
stages.summary: Provide idempotent multi-record operation coordination, compensating recovery records and failure-safe workflow boundaries for high-risk business operations.

stages.name: Runtime parity and worker authority
stages.summary: Close client approval parity and remove legacy grant/notification authority from worker runtime paths in Appwrite mode.

stages.name: Development personas and representative fixtures
stages.summary: Create repeatable seven-portal identities, entitlements and representative building, resident, contractor, inspection, maintenance and reporting fixtures.

stages.name: Structured UAT readiness
stages.summary: Add seven-portal happy-path, isolation, token, retry and recovery acceptance coverage plus a single readiness gate.

stages.name: Offline inspector field operations
stages.summary: Validate offline queue persistence, deterministic replay, conflict handling, media synchronization and recovery semantics.

stages.name: Migration dry-run and reconciliation
stages.summary: Wrap the existing migration framework in dry-run, checksum, reconciliation, rerun and recovery gates before any representative Development migration.

stages.name: Shopify Development integration
stages.summary: Validate service mappings, webhook idempotency, order linkage and bridge configuration without changing Production Shopify resources.

stages.name: Google worker Development integration
stages.summary: Validate AI, PDF, document, notification and integration workers against the canonical Appwrite outbox and delivery/result stores.

stages.name: Environment bootstrap
stages.summary: Pin and verify Node, npm, Appwrite CLI, clean Git state and safe Development environment variables before every upgrade run.

stages.name: Security and recovery hardening
stages.summary: Run secret scanning, dependency policy, tenant isolation, grant misuse, recovery and failure-injection gates.

stages.name: Testing performance polish
stages.summary: Reduce avoidable front-end bundle pressure, preserve lazy boundaries and add performance budget verification for testing.
